title: plans-migrator response
description: Output of the extension point workspace:plans-migrator. A refusal of apply is an answer (result refused with code, message and the phase it stopped at), not a protocol error. Answers hold paths relative to plans/, sizes and digests, never file content or an absolute path.

digest.description: sha256 over the sorted (path, sha256) pairs.

code.description: One error of the plan check.

where.description: Place in the plan the code refers to.

inspect.description: Manifest of plans/ of a checkout.

present.description: Whether the checkout has a plans folder.

plans.description: Plan folders and legacy folders, in the order of their names.

items.description: One folder of plans/ or plans/archive/.

name.description: Folder name relative to plans/ (archive/<id> for an archived plan).

class.description: v4 for a plan.json of the plan schema, else legacy.

files.description: Files that move (derived files are left out).

digest.description: Digest of the folder, paths relative to it.

in_progress.description: <plan>/<item> of every item in progress (v4 only).

top_level.description: Loose files of plans/ and plans/archive/ (they go to legacy-plans/_root).

symlinks.description: Symlinks and special files that block a migration.

derived_skipped.description: Number of derived entries left out (views, context, .lock, caches).

applied.description: The migration ran (applied) or there was nothing left to do (noop: the marker already points at the workspace and every copy is equal).

name.description: Folder name in the source (_root for loose files).

digest.description: Digest of the folder in the source.

stored_as.description: Name in the workspace when it differs (device suffix of an imported copy).

refused.description: The migration stopped; nothing moved before the rename and the marker is unchanged.

code.description: MIGRATION_LOCKED, MIGRATION_SOURCE_CHANGED, MIGRATION_BLOCKED_SYMLINK, MIGRATION_CONFLICT, MIGRATION_COPY_MISMATCH, MIGRATION_VERIFY_FAILED, MIGRATION_TRANSFER_FAILED, MIGRATION_ALREADY_APPLIED, MIGRATION_FAILED, PROJECT_MARKER_INVALID, PROJECT_MARKER_MISMATCH or INPUT_INVALID.

locked.description: MIGRATION_LOCKED: the plan (or the migration lock) that was held.

changed.description: MIGRATION_SOURCE_CHANGED: folders that differ from the manifest.

conflicts.description: MIGRATION_CONFLICT: plans that differ from the workspace.

paths.description: MIGRATION_COPY_MISMATCH, MIGRATION_ALREADY_APPLIED: folders whose bytes differ.

plans.description: MIGRATION_VERIFY_FAILED: the staged plans that do not verify.

loaded.description: Whether the store loaded it without problems.

new_errors.description: Errors of check the source does not have.

verify.description: Load and check result of the plans of a folder.

ok.description: Every plan loaded without problems and has no error the baseline lacks.

name.description: Plan folder relative to the verified folder.

loaded.description: Whether the store loaded it without problems.

new_errors.description: Errors the baseline lacks (only with a baseline).
